findings.title: Route names a listener the Gateway does not have
findings.cause: HTTPRoute shop attaches to listener https of Gateway public, and the Gateway has no such listener, so the route is attached to nothing; its listeners are http (port 80, HTTP)

evidence.command: kubectl get httproute shop -n kd-gateway-listener-missing -o jsonpath='{.spec.parentRefs}'

evidence.what: Gateway public has listeners http (port 80, HTTP)
evidence.command: kubectl get gateway public -n kd-gateway-listener-missing -o jsonpath='{.spec.listeners}'

findings.fix: Set the parentRef's sectionName (and port) to a listener of Gateway public, or leave them out to attach to every listener that admits the route.
